name: SSH Client
description: Secure Shell client for remote login and secure file transfer.

inputs.label: User:
inputs.help: The username for the remote connection.

inputs.label: Host/IP:
inputs.help: The remote hostname or IP address.

inputs.label: Port (-p):
inputs.help: Port to connect to on the remote host.

inputs.label: Remote Command:
inputs.help: Optional command to execute on the remote host.

inputs.label: Address Family (-4/-6):
inputs.help: Force use of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses.

inputs.label: Quiet Mode (-q)
inputs.help: Silences most warnings and diagnostic messages.

inputs.label: Identity File Path (-i):
inputs.help: Path to the identity (private key) file.

inputs.label: Upload Identity File (-i):
inputs.help: Upload the identity (private key) file for use.

inputs.label: Allow Password Auth (-o 'PasswordAuthentication=yes')
inputs.help: Enables password authentication (often required).

inputs.label: Agent Forwarding (-A)
inputs.help: Enables the forwarding of the authentication agent connection.

inputs.label: Disable Password Prompt (-n)
inputs.help: Prevents reading from stdin. Useful for background scripts.

inputs.label: Preferred Auth Method:
inputs.help: Specify the preferred authentication method.

inputs.label: Local Port Forwarding (-L):
inputs.help: Local port forwarding (L[bind_address:]port:host:hostport).

inputs.label: Remote Port Forwarding (-R):
inputs.help: Remote port forwarding (R[bind_address:]port:host:hostport).

inputs.label: Dynamic Port Forwarding (-D):
inputs.help: Dynamic port forwarding (SOCKS proxy on port).

inputs.label: Allow Remote Connections to Local Forwarded Ports (-g)
inputs.help: Allows remote hosts to connect to locally forwarded ports.

inputs.label: Do Not Execute Remote Command (-N)
inputs.help: Useful for port forwarding, prevents remote execution.

inputs.label: Config File (-F):
inputs.help: Specify an alternative per-user configuration file.

inputs.label: Cipher/Encryption (-c):
inputs.help: Select a cipher or comma-separated list of ciphers.

inputs.label: Log Level (-v):
inputs.help: Increase verbosity of debugging messages.

inputs.label: Connection Timeout (-o 'ConnectTimeout'):
inputs.help: Timeout before giving up (seconds).

inputs.label: Additional Arguments:
inputs.placeholder: Enter any other SSH arguments here.
inputs.help: Any other ssh arguments not covered by the GUI.
